author_1.denominator: Purposive neurology Author lunasai:openalex_author.A5018643148; distinct corpus Articles per non-check descriptor, induced Article populations, not person-level expertise.
author_1.sql: SELECT p.population,m.descriptor,n.name,count(DISTINCT au.subject) articles,arg_min(au.id,au.subject||m.edge_id) authorship_witness,arg_min(m.edge_id,au.subject||m.edge_id) mesh_witness FROM authorship au JOIN am m ON m.article=au.subject JOIN article a ON a.id=au.subject JOIN nodes n ON n.id=m.descriptor CROSS JOIN populations p WHERE au.object=? AND NOT m.check_tag AND (NOT p.exclude_stubs OR NOT a.stub) GROUP BY 1,2,3 QUALIFY row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY p.population ORDER BY articles DESC,m.descriptor)<=10 ORDER BY p.population,articles DESC,m.descriptor
